data.exact_reserve_text: The claims incurred, as stated within the financial statements of GBP 5.5m (2013: GBP 4.2m) includes a deterioration of GBP 0.3m on 2012 & prior years and a marginal movement on the other years of account (2013: GBP 1.4m deterioration) in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end.
data.standardized_narrative: For the 2014 financial year, Syndicate 779 experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 0.3 million in its prior year reserves, primarily impacting the 2012 and prior years of account. This adverse development is attributed to adverse claims experience related to the syndicate's long-tailed legacy portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: a deterioration of GBP 0.3m on 2012 & prior years
adverse claims experience in relation to the Syndicate's long-tailed legacy portfolio
data.data_quality_notes: The gross premium mix categories 'Scheme', 'Individual', and 'Group' are internal business classifications rather than standard regulatory/statutory classes. However, the report explicitly states that all premiums written are in respect of 'term life business', which maps to Accident & Health.
